name: LogoDraw
summary: SwiftUI component that animates a logo: it traces the outline like a pen, then reveals the fill — plus a PNG-to-Shape pipeline.
description: A SwiftUI component that draws a logo's outline as if by pen and then fades in the fill, with parameters for draw duration, easing, fill start percent, stroke width, size and replay, and Reduce Motion support. The repo also carries the process to turn a logo PNG into a clean SwiftUI Shape: Python scripts (measure, geometry, tune, compare) plus a macOS render check, and a Claude Code skill (logo-to-swiftui-draw) documenting the workflow step by step. Docs are in Brazilian Portuguese.
contains: SwiftUI component with drawDuration, fillStartPercent, replay and onComplete parameters
reduce motion: logo appears complete instantly
Python pipeline: measure.py, geometry.py, tune.py, compare.py, rendershape.sh
